title: Vintage 1990s Moscow Metro Subway Token Russia Translucent Plastic Russian
descriptionText:
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage condition with visible surface scratches, scuffs, dirt and age-related wear. Please review all photos for condition.

Description:
Vintage Moscow Metro subway fare token from Russia. Translucent yellow-green plastic construction with the Moscow Metro “М” logo in the center and Cyrillic “МОСКОВСКИЙ МЕТРОПОЛИТЕН” lettering around the edge.

This style of plastic fare token was used by the Moscow Metro during the 1990s before the system transitioned away from tokens.

Shows normal wear from circulation and age, including scratches, scuffs and surface marks. Both sides are pictured.
